item.title: Mardi Gras 2026: Date, Lent 2026 Calendar, Good Friday and Easter Sunday Dates
item.description: Mardi Gras 2026 falls on Tuesday, February 17, marking the end of the Carnival season. Ash Wednesday follows on February 18, beginning the 40-day Lenten period of fasting. item.title: Supreme Court Grants Vikram Bhatt and His Wife Shwetambari Bhatt Interim Bail in INR 30 Crore Fraud Case
item.description: The Supreme Court on Friday granted interim bail to filmmaker Vikram Bhatt and his wife, Shwetambari Bhatt, in a INR 30 crore fraud case registered in Udaipur. The couple was arrested in December 2025, will be released from judicial custody ahead of further hearing on February 19, 2026.
